title.en: A formation's couplings as its blanket, and when a blanket constrains
title.zh: 形成之耦合为其毯，及毯何时有所约束

statement.en: A formation's couplings make any model they feed a blanketed agent; degenerate readings refute no determined family, sparse ones fixed apart can fail on one run; there, step external, its level is internal to a law determined part by part exactly where level, what couples in and act fix the next.
statement.zh: 一形成之耦合使以之为食之任一模型成毯化之主体；退化之读不驳律确定之族，独立而定之稀疏之读可为一运行所驳；于此，步为外部，其层级为某逐部分确定之律之内部，恰当层级、耦合入者与作为逐对定其次。

laws.en: The coupling law: where a formation's couplings give the values of what couples into it, any model and policy, and any environment, which may read the act, make a blanketed law whose sensory part's next state is the value of what couples in at the step, the step on the world's side; its sensory course is the formation's own course through its couplings under its own level history (sensory_course and four more).
laws.zh: 耦合之律：一形成之耦合予耦合入者之值，则任一模型、策略与环境（可读其作为）成一毯化之律，感官部分之次态为当步耦合入者之值，步在世界一侧；其感官历程即该形成于自身层级历史下经其耦合之自身历程（sensory_course 等五项）。

laws.en: Two of its courses from one agent are alike on the blanket before n + 2 exactly where their own level histories are alike through the couplings up to n, the environment reading the act or not; then their internal courses agree up to n + 2. In the closed loop both sides are read off one course (blanket_iff_through, internal_through_couplings).
laws.zh: 同一主体之二历程于 n + 2 前于毯上相同，恰当其自身层级历史至 n 经耦合相同，环境读其作为与否皆然；此时其内部历程至 n + 2 相合。闭环中两侧读自同一历程（blanket_iff_through、internal_through_couplings）。

laws.en: In the open loop, the act moving no level, every reading of the internal course up to n + 2 is a selection through the formation's couplings up to n, whatever the model and the policy (internal_selectsThrough and five more).
laws.zh: 开环中（作为不移层级），无论模型与策略，内部历程至 n + 2 之每一读皆为经该形成之耦合至 n 之选择（internal_selectsThrough 等六项）。

laws.en: The threshold witness's join is its case: at the witness's web, with the supply as the environment state beside the step, the two courses correspond part by part and the witness's blanket_iff_through follows (ThresholdCase.threshold_case and ten more).
laws.zh: 阈之例之相接为其一例：于例之网，供给为步旁之环境态，二历程逐部分相应，例之 blanket_iff_through 由之而得（ThresholdCase.threshold_case 等十一项）。

laws.en: A part of the next configuration depends only on a reading where configurations agreeing under one map go, under one move, to ones agreeing under another; DependsOnlyOn and GoAlike are cases by definition, and Determined is equivalent to the case where both are the identity; the law a family shows has such a part exactly where the family is consistent under the two maps (shownBy_partDependsOnlyOn_iff and five more).
laws.zh: 次构型之一部分唯依一读：于一映射下相合之构型，经同一移，至于另一映射下相合者；DependsOnlyOn 与 GoAlike 依定义为其例，Determined 等价于二映射皆为恒等之例；族所示之律有此部分，恰当族于二映射下一致（shownBy_partDependsOnlyOn_iff 等六项）。

laws.en: A law determined part by part, the agent's parts by what the agent reads and the world's by what the world reads, moves kept, partial or not, is the blanket's form on the law a family shows: a family is admitted by one exactly where it is consistent part by part, and such a law is determined (admitted_iff and six more).
laws.zh: 逐部分确定之律（主体诸部分依主体所读，世界诸部分依世界所读，保留诸移，偏或全）为族所示之律上之毯之形：一族为此律所容，恰当其逐部分一致；此律确定（admitted_iff 等七项）。

laws.en: A blanketed law, read as a process with the trivial move, is determined part by part, and its courses form a family consistent part by part; the converse needs a next state at every reading no course shows, and is not stated (blanketed_courses_consistent and two more).
laws.zh: 毯化之律作为平凡之移之过程逐部分确定，其诸历程成逐部分一致之族；逆向需于无历程所示之每一读择一次态，未陈（blanketed_courses_consistent 等三项）。

laws.en: Parts and pairs agreeing piece by piece are one; what each side reads and its parts (parts_eq and six more).
laws.zh: 诸部分与对逐件相合则为一；每侧所读及其诸部分（parts_eq 等七项）。

laws.en: Readings of the course: with which course and the step in the external part, every family of courses is a blanketed law's course family, consistent or not; a reading of the course's future, no clock, does it for every course; with the step alone two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails and twelve more).
laws.zh: 历程之读：外部持哪一历程与步，则每一历程之族皆为一毯化之律之历程族，一致与否；读历程之未来（无时钟）亦于每一历程然；唯持步，则于第 0、1 步相同、第 2 步分离之二历程无逐部分确定之律（clock_only_fails 等十三项）。

laws.en: Readings of the configuration: the constant reading gives every family the blanket's form, the whole configuration as the internal part exactly the families whose law is determined; any injective reading gives it only where the law is determined, and not always there (whole_iff and five more).
laws.zh: 构型之读：常值之读予每一族以毯之形，整个构型为内部部分则恰予其律确定之族；任一单射之读唯于律确定处予之，且其处未必予（whole_iff 等六项）。

laws.en: A sparse partition fixed apart from the family, on a law the same at every step, can be refuted by one run: in a run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first, the run is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts, while the whole configuration reads it in the blanket's form (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed and nine more).
laws.zh: 独立于族而定之稀疏之分，于每步皆同之律，可为一运行所驳：内部部分读外部部分（三值循环）是否处其首之运行，于其自身之分下非其四部分上任一毯化之律之历程，于整个构型下则成毯之形（ReadsExternal.not_blanketed 等十项）。

laws.en: With the step as the external part, one course is consistent part by part, and admitted by some law determined part by part, exactly where its agent is consistent: at any two steps alike on the internal, sensory and active states, the next internal and active states agree; the world's half holds of every such course; tested only where the three states recur (stepExternal_admitted_iff and three more).
laws.zh: 步为外部部分，则一历程逐部分一致、且为某逐部分确定之律所容，恰当其主体一致：于内部、感官与作为之态皆相同之任二步，次内部态与次作为态皆相合；世界之半于每一此历程皆成；唯于三态复现处受检（stepExternal_admitted_iff 等四项）。

laws.en: Given functions for the next internal and active states at every step, the course is the course of a blanketed law whose internal part moves by the sensory state at its own step, whose sensory part is the given course at the next step and whose external part is the step; its world's side is the open loop at that course; the converse, the functions from consistency alone, is not stated (stepLaw, stepLaw_course).
laws.zh: 若诸函数于每步予次内部态与次作为态，则该历程为一毯化之律之历程，其内部部分依其本步之感官态而移，感官部分为下一步之所给历程，外部部分为步；其世界一侧为该历程之开环；逆向（仅由一致得诸函数）未陈（stepLaw、stepLaw_course）。

laws.en: A value across steps: two levels at any two steps have one value exactly where they admit the formation alike, each at its step, and agree on what couples into it by level; it gives the values at each step (ValuesThrough), which compare one step only and which a value carrying the step meets; where admission is decided and the couplings listed, listed_values' value meets it (listed_valuesAcross and two more).
laws.zh: 跨步之值：任二步之二层级同值，恰当其各于其步同准入该形成，且于以层级耦合入者相合；其予每步之值（ValuesThrough），后者唯比一步，携步之值满足之；准入已定且耦合已列处，listed_values 之值满足之（listed_valuesAcross 等三项）。

laws.en: One balanced run, read with a formation's level internal, a value across steps sensory, its act active and the step external, is admitted by some law determined part by part exactly where, at any two steps j and k alike on its level, admission, coupled levels and act, given at j plus taken at k equals given at k plus taken at j and next acts agree; tested only where these recur (levelParts_admitted_iff and six more).
laws.zh: 一平衡之运行，以一形成之层级为内部、跨步之值为感官、其作为为作为部分、步为外部而读，为某逐部分确定之律所容，恰当于其层级、准入、耦合入之层级与作为皆相同之任二步 j、k，j 之所予加 k 之所取等于 k 之所予加 j 之所取，且次作为相合；唯于诸态复现处受检（levelParts_admitted_iff 等七项）。

laws.en: A drain in three phases fails the level's condition for every value across steps: nothing couples into the formation; the other relatum, whose level is its phase, takes one unit from the formation at its first phase and gives one at its second, balanced at every step; at steps 2 and 3 the formation's level, value and act agree and its next levels are one and nothing (PhasedDrain.not_admitted and twenty-three more).
laws.zh: 三相之耗于每一跨步之值皆不满足层级之条件：无物耦合入该形成；另一关系项（其层级即其相）于其第一相取该形成一单位、于第二相予之一单位，每步皆平衡；于第 2、3 步该形成之层级、值与作为相合，而次层级为一与无（PhasedDrain.not_admitted 等二十四项）。

laws.en: A drain and feed in two phases meets the level's condition for any value, the level recurring: the other relatum, not coupling in, takes one unit when on and gives one when off, and the next level is fixed by the level. With the drain in three phases, whether what moves the level couples in does not decide the condition (Alternating.admitted and twenty-three more).
laws.zh: 二相之耗与供于任一值皆满足层级之条件，层级复现：另一关系项不耦合入，开时取一单位、关时予一单位，次层级由层级所定。与三相之耗并观，移层级者是否耦合入不定此条件（Alternating.admitted 等二十四项）。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Any web, formation and couplings by level, supplied, whose values the web's admission and the levels give (ValuesThrough); any model, policy, environment state, levels and environment step.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。任一网、形成与所给之层级耦合，其值由网之准入与层级所予（ValuesThrough）；任一模型、策略、环境态、层级与环境之步。

hypotheses.en: For the readings: any family of courses with moves, and any map from configurations to four parts, read by one map at every step of a law the same at every step.
hypotheses.zh: 诸读：任一带移之历程之族，及自构型至四部分之任一映射，于每步皆同之律之每一步以同一映射读之。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete synchronous steps; determined laws; the four parts of types in Type; the blanket as sparse coupling, not conditional independence; which map a thing's partition is read by is not derived.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选择：离散同步之步；确定之律；四部分之类型在 Type；毯为稀疏耦合，非条件独立；物之分以何映射而读，未推出。

hypotheses.en: For a formation's level: one run of a World (World.of R L W), balanced where the exchange form is used, the step the external part; a value across steps (ValuesAcross), the step entering only through admission at each step; the act its rows on listed relata at the steps a presence course marks, which may decide where it takes part (DecidesPresence); amounts in Nat.
hypotheses.zh: 形成之层级：一世界（World.of R L W）之一运行，用交换之形处平衡，步为外部部分；一跨步之值（ValuesAcross），步唯经各步之准入而入；作为为其于一参与历程所标之步、于所列关系项之行，该历程可定其参与与否（DecidesPresence）；量在 Nat。

does_not_show.en: That having the coupling law constrains a formation's course: it is a construction, the step on the world's side and the environment arbitrary.
does_not_show.zh: 具耦合之律约束形成之历程：此为构造，步在世界一侧，环境任意。

does_not_show.en: A formation's records other than its level as the internal part: for these the agent is a model fed by what couples in.
does_not_show.zh: 形成之层级以外之记录为内部部分：于此主体乃以耦合入者为食之模型。

does_not_show.en: The World's own exchange as an environment: the join's World case is the open loop, the closed loop a model beside it; along one run the level's reading carries the exchange in the level, the rest entering only through the step.
does_not_show.zh: 世界自身之交换为环境：相接之世界情形为开环，闭环为其旁之模型；沿一运行，层级之读以层级载其交换，余者唯经步而入。

does_not_show.en: A formation's level as the internal part across a family of runs, or with the step off the world's side, where the world's half is a condition; for self-bearing formations, whose own level couples in, nothing beyond one run with the step.
does_not_show.zh: 形成之层级于一族运行、或步不在世界一侧时为内部部分，此时世界之半成一条件；自持之形成（其自身层级耦合入）于一运行持步之外无所示。

does_not_show.en: A blanketed law for every family consistent part by part, or functions for a consistent course: a next state at every reading no course shows is needed.
does_not_show.zh: 每一逐部分一致之族皆有毯化之律，或一致之历程有诸函数：需于无历程所示之每一读择一次态。

does_not_show.en: That the principle is wrong: no sentence of its literature is forbidden here.
does_not_show.zh: 原理有误：此处不禁其文献之任何语句。

detail.en: The run whose internal part's next state is whether the external part, cycling through three values, is at its first is the course of no blanketed law on its four parts (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed).
detail.zh: 内部部分之次态为外部部分（三值循环）是否处其首之运行，非其四部分上任一毯化之律之历程（ReadsExternal.not_blanketed）。

detail.en: With the step but not which course outside, two courses alike at steps 0 and 1 and parting at 2 have no law determined part by part (clock_only_fails).
detail.zh: 外部持步而不持哪一历程，则于第 0、1 步相同、第 2 步分离之二历程无逐部分确定之律（clock_only_fails）。

detail.en: Under the identity reading, injective, a run whose law is determined is not consistent part by part (injective_converse_fails).
detail.zh: 于恒等之读（单射）下，律确定之运行非逐部分一致（injective_converse_fails）。

detail.en: Two courses from one value parting at their first step: the family is not consistent, its clocked reading consistent part by part (clocked_witness).
detail.zh: 自一值出发、于首步分离之二历程：族不一致，而其带时钟之读逐部分一致（clocked_witness）。

detail.en: A drain in three phases: nothing couples into the formation and the run balances, yet at steps 2 and 3 its level, value and act agree and its next levels differ, so for every value across steps no law determined part by part admits the run read with its level internal (PhasedDrain.not_admitted).
detail.zh: 三相之耗：无物耦合入该形成，运行平衡，然于第 2、3 步其层级、值与作为相合而次层级相异，故于每一跨步之值，以其层级为内部而读之运行不为任何逐部分确定之律所容（PhasedDrain.not_admitted）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty (core receipt 20261101T044825.244995Z): BlanketCouplings (70 theorems in 140 declarations) imports Blanket, Histories and IdentificationRuns, a leaf; no decide. Near-definitional; the delta is the classification and, for a formation's level, the condition on the World's exchange, pairwise. Reviewed by other AI agents, every finding taken: UE27's design, Lean and landing texts (fifteen, fifteen and twenty-two findings) and UE28's (fifteen, thirteen and eighteen); study sections 488 and 491; no person's review recorded.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空（核心回执 20261101T044825.244995Z）：BlanketCouplings（70 条定理，140 项声明）引 Blanket、Histories 与 IdentificationRuns，为叶。近乎定义；增量为分类，及形成之层级于世界之交换上之逐对条件。他 AI 代理审之，凡所见皆取：UE27 之设计、Lean 与落地文本（十五、十五、二十二条），UE28 者（十五、十三、十八条）；研究第 488 与 491 节；尚无人审之记录。

next_delta.en: A formation's records other than its level as the internal part of a blanketed law; its level as that part across a family of runs, where the world's half is a condition, or along one run without functions given; a blanketed law for a family consistent part by part, with a choice at the readings no course shows; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 形成之层级以外之记录为毯化之律之内部部分；其层级于一族运行（世界之半为条件）、或沿一运行而无所给之函数，为此部分；逐部分一致之族之毯化之律（于无历程所示之读择之）；人之审查。

correspondence.en: The principle defines a thing by its Markov blanket (Friston 2013, 2019; Kirchhoff and others 2018). That a blanket depends on how a partition is read is argued in words: Pearl's blankets, fixed within a model, against Friston's, read as a thing's boundary (Bruineberg, Dołęga, Dewhurst and Baltieri 2022). Wider: a formalism for any domain explains life and mind less than claimed (Raja and others 2021); statistical and dynamical blankets differ (Biehl, Pollock and Kanai 2021); its proponents concede the existence claim is not strictly falsifiable (Ramstead and others 2023). The coupling form is the deterministic time-unrolled blanket (Virgo, Rosas and Biehl 2022), which compares courses from one start, so a single run constrains nothing under it; a single run can refute a law the same at every step on the agent's side, which that blanket does not require, read by a partition fixed apart (ReadsExternal, of Hexagram.runsOrder_reads' kind; for a formation's level, PhasedDrain). The level's condition is the elementary one for one trajectory of a time-invariant deterministic state machine, here on the World's exchange. AI reading: which blanket a thing has is how its parts are read.
correspondence.zh: 原理以马尔可夫毯定一物（Friston 2013、2019；Kirchhoff 等 2018）。毯依分之读法，已以言论之：Pearl 之毯定于模型之内，与 Friston 之毯读为物之界相对（Bruineberg、Dołęga、Dewhurst、Baltieri 2022）。更广：适用于任何领域之形式，于生命与心智所释较所称为少（Raja 等 2021）；统计与动力之毯不同（Biehl、Pollock、Kanai 2021）；倡之者认存在之主张严格言之不可证伪（Ramstead 等 2023）。耦合之形即确定之时间展开之毯（Virgo、Rosas、Biehl 2022），其比较同一起点之诸历程，故其下单一运行无所约束；而单一运行可驳主体一侧每步皆同（该毯不要求此）、以独立而定之分读之之律（ReadsExternal，与 Hexagram.runsOrder_reads 同类；形成之层级则 PhasedDrain）。层级之条件即单一轨迹合于时不变确定状态机之初等条件，此处陈于世界之交换。AI 之读：物有何毯，在其诸部分如何读。

aliases: A formation's couplings as its blanket
a formation's level as the internal part

detail.en: Blanket.Blanketed, its course, agent_through_sensory and internal_through_blanket; ThresholdDrain, whose join is the coupling law's case.
detail.zh: Blanket.Blanketed、其历程、agent_through_sensory 与 internal_through_blanket；ThresholdDrain，其相接为耦合之律之一例。

detail.en: Web.ValuesThrough, courseThrough, AlikeThroughUpTo, SelectsThrough and alikeThrough_iff: the formation's own course through its couplings, which the sensory course is.
detail.zh: Web.ValuesThrough、courseThrough、AlikeThroughUpTo、SelectsThrough 与 alikeThrough_iff：形成经其耦合之自身历程，即感官历程。

detail.en: ShownBy, ConsistentFamily, Admits, shownBy_le_iff and shownBy_determined_iff: the law a family shows, read part by part.
detail.zh: ShownBy、ConsistentFamily、Admits、shownBy_le_iff 与 shownBy_determined_iff：族所示之律，逐部分而读。

detail.en: Flow.BalancedHistory and Web.CoupledInto: the balanced history the level's condition reads, and the coupling the witnesses deny.
detail.zh: Flow.BalancedHistory 与 Web.CoupledInto：层级之条件所读之平衡之史，及见证所否之耦合。

detail.en: Hexagram.runsOrder_reads: a line-by-line reading of a law the same at every step refuted, the same kind of witness as ReadsExternal.
detail.zh: Hexagram.runsOrder_reads：逐爻之读于每步皆同之律上被驳，与 ReadsExternal 同类之见证。

detail.en: The blanket's statistical form; this record states the coupling form's existence and when it constrains.
detail.zh: 毯之统计之形；本记录陈耦合之形之存在及其何时有所约束。

detail.en: The existence claim's weighting form, which forbids only with a weighting fixed apart from the course; the coupling form is refuted under a sparse partition fixed apart from the family, a degenerate reading refuting no family whose law is determined.
detail.zh: 存在之主张之权之形，唯以独立于历程而定之权禁之；耦合之形于独立于族而定之稀疏之分下被驳，退化之读不驳任何其律确定之族。

history.en: 1 November 2026: added (UE27), which blanket a thing has: any model fed by what couples into a formation is by construction the agent of a blanketed law whose sensory course is the formation's own course, the threshold witness's join its case; the three levels at which a blanket's existence constrains; after reviews of the design, the Lean and the landing texts, every finding taken; study section 488.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日：新增（UE27），物有何毯：以耦合入一形成者为食之任一模型依构造为一毯化之律之主体，其感官历程即该形成之自身历程，阈之例之相接为其一例；毯之存在有所约束之三层；经设计、Lean 与落地文本之审查，凡所见皆取；研究第 488 节。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item UE28 (study section 491): a formation's level as the internal part along one run, the step external: admitted by a law determined part by part exactly where its next level and act agree wherever its level, a value across steps of what couples in and its act agree, on the World's records an equation between what is given to it and taken from it at the two steps, tested only where these recur; a drain in three phases fails it, a drain and feed in two phases meets it; six laws (64 declarations) added, the statement, a hypothesis, the correspondence, does_not_show, a dependency and the next step brought to it; after reviews of the design and the Lean and of the landing texts, every finding taken.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 UE28（研究第 491 节）：形成之层级沿一运行为内部部分，步为外部：为某逐部分确定之律所容，恰当其层级、耦合入者跨步之值与作为相合之处，其次层级与次作为皆相合，于世界之记录即二步所予所取之等式，唯于诸态复现处受检；三相之耗不满足之，二相之耗与供满足之；新增六律（64 项声明），陈述、一前提、对应、所不示、一依赖与下一步随之；经设计与 Lean 及落地文本之审查，凡所见皆取。

history.en: 6 November 2026, board item LM: the helper lemmas this record lists are stated once now, in Prelude, Flow, Change or Laws, or are Lean's own and dropped from the lists; the names changed and no law did.
history.zh: 2026年11月6日，工作板条目 LM：此记录所列辅助引理现只陈述一次，在 Prelude、Flow、Change 或 Laws，或即 Lean 自有者而从列表除去；改其名，诸律不变。
